name: kotlin-analyzer
description: Kotlin for VS Code: highlighting, the kotlin-analyzer language server (navigation, completion, diagnostics, rename) and its debugger, also for Java.

task.markdownDescription: `build`: `gradle build -x test`; `clean`: `gradle clean`; `test`: `gradle test --rerun-tasks` in the project at `path` and its subprojects.

path.markdownDescription: A file or directory in the build, e.g. `${file}` or `${workspaceFolder}/services`. For `test`, the project holding it is tested.

tests.markdownDescription: For `test`: only the tests this filter names (Gradle's `--tests`, e.g. `app.OrderTest` or `app.OrderTest.creates an order`), in the project holding `path`.

test.markdownDescription: A test, run by Gradle's test task in its file's project with the debugger attached to the test JVM: `file` and Gradle's `--tests` `filter` (`shop.OrderTest.creates an order`) — or the filter's pieces `package`, `outerClass`, `class`, `method`.

file.markdownDescription: The test's file: its Gradle project is the nearest directory with a build script.

program.markdownDescription: Instead of `test`: `java`, or Gradle (`${workspaceFolder}/gradlew`, `gradle`), whose `Test` and `JavaExec` JVMs (`bootRun` is one) get the debugger.

cwd.markdownDescription: Where the program runs: the Gradle build's root for Gradle.

port.markdownDescription: The debug port of a JVM started with `-agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,address=5005`.

cwd.markdownDescription: The project whose sources the frames map to.

configurationSnippets.label: kotlin-analyzer: Gradle program
configurationSnippets.description: Debug the JVM a Gradle task runs (`bootRun`, `run`).

configurationSnippets.label: kotlin-analyzer: test
configurationSnippets.description: Debug the tests a Gradle filter names.

configurationSnippets.label: kotlin-analyzer: attach
configurationSnippets.description: Attach to a JVM listening for a debugger.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A `var`: a variable or property that can be reassigned.

kotlin-analyzer.server.path.markdownDescription: The server binary to run. When unset: `kotlin-analyzer` on the `PATH`, else the release matching this extension, downloaded from GitHub on first use.

kotlin-analyzer.server.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Environment variables added to the server's, e.g. `JAVA_HOME` for the JDK it reads.

kotlin-analyzer.java.enable.markdownDescription: Also serve Java files (navigation, hover, symbols). Turn it off when another Java language server runs.

kotlin-analyzer.diagnostics.experimental.markdownDescription: Also run the checks that haven't passed the corpus gate yet (`unresolved-reference`).

enumDescriptions: ktrs: ktfmt's output from a native binary, without a JVM.
ktfmt itself: its native build on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64, its jar (needing Java) elsewhere.
No formatting by the server: leave it to another formatter.
kotlin-analyzer.formatting.formatter.markdownDescription: The formatter *Format Document* runs. Unless `#kotlin-analyzer.formatting.path#` is set, it's the one on the `PATH`, else its pinned release, downloaded on first use with its SHA-256 checked.

kotlin-analyzer.formatting.style.markdownDescription: The style the formatter formats in.

kotlin-analyzer.formatting.path.markdownDescription: The formatter's executable, or ktfmt's `.jar` (run with `java` from `JAVA_HOME` or the `PATH`), instead of the one on the `PATH` or the download.

kotlin-analyzer.codeLens.references.markdownDescription: Show how many references each declaration has above it; clicking one shows them.

kotlin-analyzer.codeLens.tests.markdownDescription: Show *▶ Run test* above test functions and *▶ Run tests* above the classes holding them (JUnit 4 and 5, kotlin.test, TestNG): Gradle's test task with `--tests`, in the file's project.

kotlin-analyzer.gradleExport.markdownDescription: Export the Gradle build's model (modules, source sets, libraries, JDK) in the background on opening the workspace.

kotlin-analyzer.projectJson.markdownDescription: A project model exported beforehand (`.kotlin-analyzer/project.json`), used instead of exporting one.

kotlin-analyzer.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the LSP traffic to the *kotlin-analyzer* output.

scripts.check: tsc -p . --noEmit && npm run test:unit && npm run test:grammar
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p . && node out/test/integration/run.js
